graph_sha256_method: SHA-256 of the canonical N-Triples (RDFC-1.0; no blank nodes)
text_sha256_method: SHA-256 (UTF-8) of the JSON array [header, row, ...], each an array of strings (empty cell ""), rows sorted by the key columns in code point order, json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).

scope.rule: The concepts of the SDTM CT rows in scope (sdtm-ct graph, column Code, codelist and term rows), the COSMoS Biomedical Concepts (cosmos graph, column ncit_code of cdisc_biomedical_concepts_latest), the COSMoS data element concepts (column ncit_dec_code of the same table) and the SDTM v2.0 Model variable C-codes (sdtm-model graph, column Variable C-Code), with all their ancestors by the column parents (codes separated by "|"). A concept of the scope without a row in this file is listed, not an error; a parent without a row stops the reader.
